mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saved_view (owner_id, dashboard_id, name, description, filter_state, is_default, is_shared, shared_with) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{dashboardId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{filterState}::jsonb, #{isDefault}, #{isShared}, #{sharedWith,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE saved_view SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, filter_state = #{filterState}::jsonb, is_default = #{isDefault}, is_shared = #{isShared}, shared_with = #{sharedWith,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, dashboard_id, name, description, filter_state::text AS filter_state, is_default, is_shared, shared_with, created_at, last_used_at FROM saved_view WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, owner_id, dashboard_id, name, description, filter_state::text AS filter_state, is_default, is_shared, shared_with, created_at, last_used_at FROM saved_view WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND dashboard_id = #{dashboardId} ORDER BY last_used_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE saved_view SET last_used_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
